QR SLOP · free, in your browser

Make a Wi-Fi QR code

Guests point their phone camera at the code and join the network, without typing a long password. Print it for the hallway, a café table, an Airbnb or an office meeting room.

Make a Wi-Fi QR code

How to do it

  1. The Wi-Fi form is open. Type the Network name (SSID).
  2. Choose the Security (WPA / WPA2, WEP or None) and type the Password. Tick Hidden network if it does not broadcast its name.
  3. Change the colours or add a logo in the Design and Logo tabs if you like.
  4. Download a PNG or SVG, or Print page (PDF) for a sheet with the code and its name.

Your files stay on this device: QR SLOP runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Which phones can scan it?

Current iPhones and Android phones read Wi-Fi codes with the built-in camera and offer to join the network.

Is my Wi-Fi password sent anywhere?

No. The code is made in your browser, and the password is only inside the picture you download.

What if I change the password?

Make a new code. The password is stored in the code itself, so an old code stops working when the password changes.
